title: Reduce torsion cohomology vanishing to bounded exponent
statement: Let $X$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme and $q$ a natural number. Use torsion abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-torsion-etale-sheaf] and cohomology [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. If $H^q(X,G)=0$ for every abelian etale sheaf $G$ annihilated by some positive integer $N$, then $H^q(X,F)=0$ for every torsion abelian etale sheaf $F$.

proof.text: The source theorem Etale.subsingleton_H_of_isTorsion is already proved. Its explicit diagram is K_n=ker((n+1)!·id_F), ordered by n. Factorial divisibility gives the inclusions. Every local torsion section locally belongs to some K_n, and the mono locally-surjective cocone is a colimit. Each K_n is annihilated by (n+1)!, so its degree-q cohomology vanishes by hypothesis. Cohomology commutes with this filtered colimit on qcqs X, so H^q(X,F)=0. This is the original filtered-union and cohomology-colimit argument with cofinal factorial indexing.
